newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ofwat wants pricing to reflect investments.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ofwat wants pricing to reflect investments.

text.p: UK water industry watchdog Ofwat would like to see companies trimming price increases to reflect fluctuations in investment from plans on an annual basis.

Ofwat director general Ian Byatt, at a conference in Birmingham, suggested that "if, in one year, investment is below what was anticipated over the comparable period of the price caps, companies (could) abate their take-up of the full price limit."
Price caps and investment targets for the water and sewage industry are set on a 10-year basis with the next review expected in 2000.
Byatt said because of the fluctuating nature of investment needs he believed companies should "adjust the take up of prices within the medium term price limit on an annual basis."
